architecture: Gemma4ForCausalLM (text_config; vision tower and embedding_projection out of scope by contract)
revision_note: HF repo commit pinned by the independent anchor kit (batch-gemma4-val ANCHORS.md); warm config.json and model.safetensors.index.json are byte-identical to the publisher snapshots at that commit

scope.vision_tower: model.vision_tower.* + model.embed_vision.embedding_projection.weight out of scope by contract (full-attention stack only)
scope.decode_only_v1: prefill fails closed in the v1 module; boundaries per DESIGN section 7

sources.verification: HF LFS sha256 oid equality at the pinned revision plus byte-exact size equality on warm; config.json and model.safetensors.index.json sha256 computed twice (workstation + sparka); full shard sha256 confirmation on sparka

model.embed_scale_note: bf16(sqrt(5376)); fp32 buffer cast to bf16 at multiply, the rounding is load-bearing
model.softcap_note: inert for v1: logits-only, monotone under greedy argmax (ruling against Gemma4ForCausalLM.forward)
model.eos_note: generation_config.json eos_token_id; the header binds all three
model.layer_types: 5 sliding_attention : 1 full_attention, full at index 5 mod 6 (config layer_types, 60 entries)

sliding.type: default rope, theta 10000, whole-head rotation (128 pairs of 256 dims)

full.type: proportional rope, base 1e6, partial_rotary_factor 0.25 -> 64 rotated pairs, inv_freq[i] = 1e6**(-i/256) for i < 64 then 0
full.k_eq_v: no v_proj tensor; v = scale-free per-head RMS of the raw k projection, taken before k_norm/rope

attention.scaling: qk_scale exactly 1.0 (q-norm makes q RMS 1); softcap none in attention
attention.norms: q_norm/k_norm per-head with weight; v_norm per-head without weight (with_scale=False, no tensor in the index)

topology.kv_replication: sliding kv 16/16 exact per rank; full kv 4 global heads replicated x4, rank r reads head r/4; per-rank KV_HEADS 1 both kinds
topology.determinism_note: v = v_norm(raw k) chain safe at TP16: column-parallel kraw on identical post-reduce residual, per-head-local norm/rope, bitwise-identical replicas

pack_folds.sliding_kv_row_fusion: k|v rows fused per DESIGN section 6
pack_folds.full_kv_replication: rank r -> global head r/(tp/kv) at pack time
pack_folds.layer_scalar: assert all-ones fail-closed at pack time

lane_pack_policy.nvfp4_seam: payload size math only in v1; never quantize

digest_freeze.policy: small files hashed on workstation and sparka (agreement); shard sha256 = HF LFS oid at the pinned revision with byte-exact warm size equality, local sparka hash confirmation recorded in the lane report

tensor_census.v_proj_note: x50: the 10 full layers carry no v_proj (attention_k_eq_v); sliding layers are 50

qualification.status: driver aligned to the 50bd0d3 platform; oracle + validator consuming the anchor fixtures; bring-up pending
